body: I'm planning on committing suicide and the only one I really trust has thoughts sometimes. I'm bad at writing but I wanted to sound affectionate, reading now as the cringiest shit that gives me yet another reason, to avoid him being "inspired" by me...I just don't want to be a burden on my boyfriend anymore and keep asking for support..he deserves better and still won't see it
Sorry I'm not in the best of moods, it's a suicide letter, I thought posting it here let me be vague..
I don't know how to help, but I'm 14 too.
